params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Weapon:}} '''Kai'Sa''' can evolve each of her {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} by gaining a set amount of permanent [[Champion statistic|stats]] from [[item]]s and {{tt|stat growth|Includes all stats gained when leveling (including base AD gained), but does not include stats at level 1.}}, granting them additional effects. params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Plasma:}} '''Kai'Sa's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' apply {{tip|stacks}} of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times. params.effect radius: {{tip|er|icononly=true}} {{tt|3000|Radius for allied disables to apply Plasma}}

blurb.plain: Innate - Living Weapon: Kai'Sa can permanently evolve each of her basic abilities by obtaining attack damage, ability power, and attack speed, respectively.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Plasma: Kai'Sa applies stacks of Plasma through basic attacks, Void Seeker, and allied polymorphs and immobilizing effects.

blurb3.plain: Innate - Caustic Wounds: Applying Plasma deals an increasing amount of magic damage. Upon applying the final stack, all stacks are consumed to deal additional magic damage based on the target's missing health.

description.plain: Innate - Living Weapon: Kai'Sa can evolve each of her basic abilities by gaining a set amount of permanent stats from items and stat growth, granting them additional effects. Evolving an ability causes her to enter a 2-second cast time. The upgrade is lost if the stat requirement is no longer met.

description2.plain: Innate - Plasma: Kai'Sa's basic attacks on-hit and Void Seeker apply stacks of Plasma to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times. Basic attacks each apply 1 stack and Void Seeker applies 2 stacks, increased to 3 if it is Void Seeker 2. Her and nearby allies' immobilizing effects and polymorphs against enemy champions will also apply a stack of Plasma.

description3.plain: Innate - Caustic Wounds: Plasma stacks applied by Kai'Sa's basic attacks or Void Seeker deal 4 – 30 (based on level) (+ 12% AP) additional magic damage plus 1 – 8 (based on level) (+ 3% AP) additional magic damage per Plasma stack on the target before application, up to a total of 8 – 62 (based on level) (+ 24% AP) additional magic damage at 4 Plasma stacks before application. The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal additional magic damage equal to 15% (+ 6% per 100 AP) of the target's missing health, capped at 400 against monsters.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kai'Sa}} shoots a swarm of missiles that evenly seek out nearby enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.
params.blurb4:
{{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Living Weapon}} Bonus:}} ['''Requires {{sti|{{as|attack damage}}}}''']
''Icathian Rain'' fires more missiles.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' releases a swarm of 6 missiles that evenly distributes among nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each one hitting their target after {{fd|0.4}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}}. {{tip|Minions}} below {{sti|health|{{as|35% health}}}} take double damage.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Missile|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
params.description2: Non-minions take {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage from missiles beyond their first.
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|dam_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack damage}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100 attack damage}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Icathian Rain'' instead fires 12 missiles.
params.description4: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability.''
params.notes:
* The first missile on a target applies {{tip|area damage}}, while the rest on the same target apply {{tip|persistent area damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} only block the damage from a single missile.
* ''Icathian Rain'' acquires its targets upon cast. Moving will not change its targets.
* Charging {{ai|Supercharge|Kai'Sa}} will not stop the missiles from firing.
* It takes 1 second for all missiles to fire at a single target.

blurb.plain: Active: Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that evenly seek out nearby enemies, dealing physical damage.

description3.plain: Second Skin: Requires⟦pplevel⟧ attack damage from itemsto upgrade – Icathian Rain instead fires 12 missiles.

blurb.plain: Active: Kai'Sa fires a void bolt in the target direction that grants sight around its trajectory as it travels and deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, revealing them for a few seconds.

blurb4.plain: Second Skin Bonus: [Requires ability power] Void Seeker applies more Plasma and reduces the cooldown if it hits an enemy champion.

description.plain: Active: Kai'Sa fires a void bolt in the target direction that briefly grants sight around its trajectory as it travels, deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, applies 2 Plasma, and reveals them for 4 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kai'Sa}} briefly becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' move speed|ms}}}} during the cast time, then gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.blurb4:
{{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Living Weapon}} Bonus:}} ['''Requires {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}''']
''Supercharge'' briefly grants {{tip|invisibility}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed.}}|as}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Minimum Movement Speed|{{ap|55 to 75}}%|Maximum Movement Speed|{{ap|55*2 to 75*2}}%}}
params.description2: After completing the charge, she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed.
params.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|as|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|key=%|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|as_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack speed}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100% attack speed}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Supercharge'' grants {{tip|invisibility}} at the start of the cast time for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* Her attack commands during this time are switched to movement commands instead. Upon finishing the charge and if an attack command was issued, '''Kai'Sa''' will continue walking toward her target.
** '''Kai'Sa''' behaves normally if attack move click was issued not on a target during the cast time, stopping at attack range of the closest target and starts attacking when charged up.
params.tips:
* If ''Supercharge's'' cast time finished while its buff is still active, the movement speed buff lingers briefly longer.
** This is only possible with a significantly high amount of {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}} and {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Kai'Sa briefly becomes ghosted and gains bonus move speed during the cast time, then gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

blurb4.plain: Second Skin Bonus: [Requires attack speed] Supercharge briefly grants invisibility.

description.plain: Active: Kai'Sa charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming ghosted and gaining bonus movement speed for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by 0% – 100% (based on bonus attack speed).

description2.plain: After completing the charge, she gains bonus attack speed for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower windup of (0.1/⟦ccd⟧)*100% and an increased missile speed.

description3.plain: Supercharge's current cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds on-attack.

description4.plain: Second Skin: Requires⟦pplevel⟧ attack speed from itemsto upgrade – Supercharge grants invisibility at the start of the cast time for 0.5 seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kai'Sa}} briefly {{tip|shields}} herself and {{tip|dashes}} near an enemy champion affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a target location near a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion that was {{tt|affected|Stack application or consumption}} by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} within the last 4 seconds. The shield's duration is refreshed when the dash ends.
params.description2: ''An enemy champion within range and affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Killer Instinct {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attack timer. '''Kai'Sa''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''
params.notes:
* '''Kai'Sa''' will issue a movement command to the targeted location regardless of whether the target location is valid. The dash is not buffered during this movement command. '''Kai'Sa''' will not dash if the targeted location becomes valid by walking in range or a nearby enemy champion becomes affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
** If the targeted location is not valid, the range indicator will glow.
* The enemy champion recently affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} must be in range of '''Kai'Sa''' for the targeted location to be valid, and not the targeted location itself.

blurb.plain: Active: Kai'Sa briefly shields herself and dashes near an enemy champion affected by Plasma.

description.plain: Active: Kai'Sa grants herself a shield for 2 seconds and dashes to a target location near a visible enemy champion that was affected by Plasma within the last 4 seconds. The shield's duration is refreshed when the dash ends.

description2.plain: An enemy champion within range and affected by Plasma is required to cast this ability. Killer Instinct resets Kai'Sa's basic attack timer. Kai'Sa can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
